summary: A newcomer paired with an adviser has one person to ask, which helps the newcomer learn and stay.
realLife: Gallup advised that giving each new hire a mentor or adviser provides a go-to person for questions, supporting learning, growth and retention.
sources: Gallup, Create an exceptional onboarding journey for new employees: https://www.gallup.com/workplace/353096/create-exceptional-onboarding-journey-new-employees.aspx
inGame: coworker tie flagged as mentor on the job record; closeness grows with questions asked.

turns.summary: They meet often and the tie closes.
Questions go unanswered and the newcomer asks others.
turns.writesBack: mentor tie thin; other coworker ties form

turns.summary: The newcomer later passes the mentor in skill.
